newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares finish mostly lower, Eni dominates.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares finish mostly lower, Eni dominates.

text.p: Italian shares closed mostly lower on Tuesday but above the lows, lifted by Wall Street's stronger opening, after tracking the gyrations of the Italian bond futures market throughout most of the day.
The blue chip MIB30 index finished 1.21 percent down at 14,541 while the all-share Mibtel index ended the day 1.08 percent at 9,682.

Oil giant ENI, whose new offering of shares has been eagerly snapped up by retail and institutional investors, took the limelight, closing 0.61 percent higher at 7,234 lire, up from the day's low of 7,030 lire.
"ENI was lifted by some shortcovering and by buying from investors who thought maybe it had fallen a bit too far," said a Milan-based stockbroker.
Insurers fared badly, led by Generali, ending 1.78 percent lower at 29,428 lire and Alleanza, which finished 2.65 percent lower at 10,854 lire.
Trading volume totalled more than 630 billion lire, swollen by turnover of 230 billion lire in Eni shares.
Among industrials Fiat, Olivetti and Montedison all closed slightly lower although Pirelli finished the day fractionally higher. $=1,516 lire
